title: Strike Force
author: Christopher Drum
description: Strike Force is a homage to the after-school cartoons of the 80s, most especially G.I. Joe. In this game, you'll lead two elite agents of Strike Force against the forces of HAVOC as they infiltrate a secret research lab in the depths of the Arctic Ocean. Can you get in and out with the evidence you need to help Strike Force defeat HAVOC's latest evil plans? Tune in to today's thrilling episode of Strike Force!
